name: @picteus/feature-view-grammar
description: TypeSpec meta-model and visual grammar for describing the graphical representation of image features in Picteus.

scripts.deploy:emitter: shx mkdir -p ../core/src/generated && shx cp dist/typescript/featureViewGrammar.ts ../core/src/generated && shx mkdir -p ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated && mkdir -p ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated && shx cp dist/typescript/featureViewGrammar.ts ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated && shx mkdir -p ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated && shx cp dist/python/feature_view_grammar.py ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated && mkdir -p ../../front-end/src/generated && shx cp dist/react/FeatureViewGrammar.tsx ../../front-end/src/generated
scripts.build: npm run build:emitter && npm run run:emitter && npm run deploy:emitter
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
